next_question: At one finalized canonical block, do documented identities and fee/unit/inventory conditions permit further evaluation, and which of four fixed Uniswap V3 DAI/USDC fee-tier pools are returned?
observations: Ordinary sellGem(usr,gemAmt) and buyGem(usr,gemAmt) lack an authorization modifier. NoFee versions require bud[msg.sender]==1 and are excluded.
C=10**(18-gem.decimals()); ordinary sellGem pays gemAmt*C-floor(gemAmt*C*tin/10**18) DAI; ordinary buyGem charges gemAmt*C+floor(gemAmt*C*tout/10**18) DAI.
Each direction rejects its respective fee equal to HALTED=2**256-1. The source fee setter otherwise requires at most10**18.
sellGem transfers USDC from caller to pocket and DAI from PSM to beneficiary. buyGem transfers DAI from caller to PSM and USDC from pocket to beneficiary using the PSM allowance.
Existing DAI balance at PSM and USDC balance/allowance at pocket constrain a snapshot route. No fill/trim/chug transaction or future replenishment is assumed.
The fee and inventory reads can be invalidated by later calls or governance. Source formulas alone do not prove deployed bytecode, usable token transfers, executable price, gas or profit.
